title: All four companions (Vell, Tamsin, Brother Osk, Lys) join for free with no stated cost, limit, or tension, and auto-fight every combat alongside the player. Nearly every fight resolved in one or two exchanges, so combat never felt like a real risk once the party filled out.
where: party recruitment across the Vale/'come with me' dialogue option
